basic_details.job_title: Gauhati High Court Law Clerk Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Gauhati High Court at Guwahati (The High Court of Assam, Nagaland, Mizoram and Arunachal Pradesh) is engaging 5 (five) Law Clerks at its Principal Seat in Guwahati on a fixed monthly pay of Rs. 30,000/-, purely on a contractual and temporary basis, initially for 2 years extendable by 1 (one) year. Graduates, Post Graduates or Doctorates in Law from any recognized University in India may apply online on ghconline.gov.in from 26 November 2026 (from 03:00 PM) to 10 December 2026 (till 05:00 PM). The application fee can be paid until 15 December 2026, till Bank transaction hour.

age_limit.details: The age limit is counted as on the last date of submission of the online application (10 December 2026). | Category Maximum Age Limit Unreserved (UR) 40 years OBC/MOBC 43 years SC/ST(P)/ST(H) 45 years | For Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD), the relaxation in the maximum age limit will be as per rules. OBC/MOBC candidates must produce a valid non-creamy layer certificate from the competent authority at the time of document verification before the interview/viva-voce, without fail. The certificate for claiming the benefit of reservation must be issued by the competent authority.

how_to_apply: Applications are accepted only online. An application made in any other mode will be summarily rejected without any communication.
Keep a valid e-mail ID and mobile number ready; both are mandatory for registration, and the e-mail ID should be kept active.
Log on to https://ghconline.gov.in and click on "Online application for temporary engagement of Law Clerk in the Principal Seat of the Gauhati High Court, 2026-27".
Complete the registration and note down the Registration Code, since the acknowledgement e-mail may not be delivered because of network congestion.
Fill in all the necessary details, following the procedure given in the portal.
Upload clear scanned copies of the documents listed below, along with the photograph and signature.
Pay the application fee by 15 December 2026, till Bank transaction hour. The notice does not mention the payment method.
Age proof (Class X admit card/Birth certificate)
Photograph and signature (an application without them is liable to be rejected summarily)
Original testimonials on educational qualification, date of birth, caste (if applicable) and working experience (if applicable), to be produced at later stages when asked for

For technical help with the online form, email [email protected] with the name of the post in the subject line, and the Registration Code (if any), the applicant's name and father's name and the grievance in the body of the e-mail. A copy of the e-mail should also be sent to [email protected].

content_sections.heading: About Gauhati High Court Law Clerks
content_sections.text: The Gauhati High Court is the High Court of Assam, Nagaland, Mizoram and Arunachal Pradesh, with its Principal Seat in Guwahati. The recruitment is run by the Registrar (Administration)-cum-In-Charge, Centralized Recruitment. All 5 Law Clerks will be engaged at the Principal Seat in Guwahati. The notice does not give a category-wise break-up of the 5 posts.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Applications are invited from eligible citizens of India, as defined under Articles 5 and 6 of the Constitution of India. Candidates must possess the qualification as on the last date of submission of the online application. For the exact eligibility wording, candidates should refer to the official notification. The age limit is counted as on the last date of submission of the online application (10 December 2026). For Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD), the relaxation in the maximum age limit will be as per rules. OBC/MOBC candidates must produce a valid non-creamy layer certificate from the competent authority at the time of document verification before the interview/viva-voce, without fail. The certificate for claiming the benefit of reservation must be issued by the competent authority.

rows.essential_qualification: Graduate/Post Graduate in Law or Doctorate in Law from any recognized University in India
rows.preference: Candidates practicing at the Bar or having professional experience or literary works in Law to their credit

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: A Law Clerk gets a fixed monthly pay of Rs. 30,000/- (Rupees thirty thousand) only. The notice names no allowance on top of this amount. The engagement is purely contractual and temporary, and the attachment of Law Clerks is initially for 2 (two) years, extendable by 1 (one) year. The terms and conditions of engagement, including the duties, functions and code of conduct, are regulated by Notification No. HC.V-34/2020/904/Estt. (Pt.-II) dated 02-11-2024 issued by the Gauhati High Court. The duties and functions of a Law Clerk are as mentioned in that notification. The engagement may at any time be terminated without assigning any reason if so recommended by the Judge under whom the Law Clerk has been working. At the time of engagement, every Law Clerk must give a written undertaking to strictly follow the code of conduct and the duties and functions of Law Clerks. In case of a breach, the service may be terminated by the appointing authority after considering the Law Clerk's explanation, if any. A Law Clerk is subject to the Rules applicable to the employees of the Gauhati High Court as to conduct and in matters not specifically provided. A Law Clerk shall not practise Law in any court or undertake legal service for any client during the tenure as Law Clerk.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Gauhati High Court Law Clerks
content_sections.text: Applications are accepted only online. An application made in any other mode will be summarily rejected without any communication. Keep a valid e-mail ID and mobile number ready; both are mandatory for registration, and the e-mail ID should be kept active. Log on to https://ghconline.gov.in and click on "Online application for temporary engagement of Law Clerk in the Principal Seat of the Gauhati High Court, 2026-27". Complete the registration and note down the Registration Code, since the acknowledgement e-mail may not be delivered because of network congestion. Fill in all the necessary details, following the procedure given in the portal. Upload clear scanned copies of the documents listed below, along with the photograph and signature. Pay the application fee by 15 December 2026, till Bank transaction hour. The notice does not mention the payment method. Age proof (Class X admit card/Birth certificate) Educational qualification document (Pass certificate) Caste certificate (if applicable) Photograph and signature (an application without them is liable to be rejected summarily) Original testimonials on educational qualification, date of birth, caste (if applicable) and working experience (if applicable), to be produced at later stages when asked for For technical help with the online form, email [email protected] with the name of the post in the subject line, and the Registration Code (if any), the applicant's name and father's name and the grievance in the body of the e-mail. A copy of the e-mail should also be sent to [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection is in two stages: a Written Examination (Stage-I) and an Interview/Viva-Voce (Stage-II). The written examination is objective type (multiple choice) of 120 marks and 2 hours (120 minutes) duration, on OMR sheets. A candidate must secure at least 40% marks (8 out of 20) in the Assamese Language Proficiency segment to qualify in the written examination. The marks in this segment are not counted when the merit list is prepared. The answer keys will be uploaded on the official website after the examination. The interview carries 30 marks. Candidates in the ratio of 1:3, in order of merit in the written examination, will be called for the interview and verification of documents. A candidate must secure at least 60% marks (18 out of 30) in the interview to be considered qualified. The final merit list is prepared on the total marks in the written examination and the interview. If two or more candidates have the same grand total, the one with more marks in the written examination gets preference; if those marks are also equal, the candidate senior in age gets preference. The Gauhati High Court reserves the right to fix or alter the cut-off mark in the written examination and interview. The date of the written examination is not specified in the notice.

faq.question: Q1. How many Law Clerk posts has the Gauhati High Court advertised?
faq.answer: The Gauhati High Court has advertised 5 (five) posts of Law Clerks at its Principal Seat in Guwahati.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the Gauhati High Court Law Clerk posts?
faq.answer: The online application must be submitted by 10 December 2026, till 05:00 PM, and the fee paid by 15 December 2026, till Bank transaction hour.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for a Gauhati High Court Law Clerk?
faq.answer: A candidate must be a Graduate/Post Graduate in Law or Doctorate in Law from any recognized University in India, with preference to those practicing at the Bar or having professional experience or literary works in Law.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Gauhati High Court Law Clerk posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age, as on the last date of online application, is 40 years for UR, 43 years for OBC/MOBC and 45 years for SC/ST(P)/ST(H); PwBD relaxation is as per rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of a Gauhati High Court Law Clerk?
faq.answer: A Law Clerk gets a fixed monthly pay of Rs. 30,000/-.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 500/- for UR/OBC/MOBC, Rs. 250/- for SC/ST (P)/ST (H) and NIL for PwBD candidates.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for the Gauhati High Court Law Clerk posts?
faq.answer: Apply online at https://ghconline.gov.in through the link "Online application for temporary engagement of Law Clerk in the Principal Seat of the Gauhati High Court, 2026-27"; applications in any other mode will be rejected.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for Gauhati High Court Law Clerks?
faq.answer: Selection is through a 120-mark objective written examination (Stage-I) followed by a 30-mark Interview/Viva-Voce (Stage-II), with the final merit list based on the total of both.

faq.question: Q9. Is knowledge of Assamese compulsory for the Law Clerk written exam?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates must score at least 8 out of 20 marks in the Assamese Language Proficiency segment to qualify, though these marks are not counted in the merit list.

faq.question: Q10. Is the Gauhati High Court Law Clerk job permanent?
faq.answer: No, the engagement is purely contractual and temporary, initially for 2 years and extendable by 1 year, and a Law Clerk may not practise law during the tenure.
